open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant identity minting
open_points.question: Who allocates grant_id when an administrator gives access, and is it a fresh identifier or derived from viewer_id, project_id, or another value?
options: The backend generates a fresh UUID for every new grant record.
The administrator-facing caller supplies grant_id.
The backend derives grant_id from the pair plus an unspecified generation value.
open_points.default_guess: The backend generates a fresh UUID for every new grant record.

witness.initial: Viewer V has no grant for project P.
events: An administrator gives V access to P.
An administrator gives V access to P again.
outcomes: The backend mints two distinct grant_id values.
A caller or derivation rule determines the identifiers, potentially producing a different identity history.
witness.observer: An administrator or auditor reading the grant history.

open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant lifecycle invariants
open_points.question: Must every newly created grant start active with revoked_at and revoked_by absent, and must revocation atomically change status to revoked and populate both revocation fields?
options: Creation always produces active with both revocation fields absent; revocation sets status and both fields together.
The transition constrains only status; either revocation field may remain absent or be populated independently.
Records may also be created directly in revoked status.
open_points.default_guess: Creation always produces active with both revocation fields absent; revocation sets status and both fields together.

witness.initial: An active grant exists for viewer V and project P.
outcomes: The stored record is revoked and has both revoked_at and revoked_by.
The stored record is revoked while one or both revocation fields remain absent.
witness.observer: An administrator or auditor inspecting the record.

open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant history reads
open_points.text:
revoked
grants of the pair stay as history.
open_points.question: Which product action, if any, reads the retained revoked grants, and does an administrator-facing grant read return all generations or only the current active grant?
options: Authorization reads only the active grant, while an administrator history or audit action reads every generation.
All grant reads return active and revoked generations.
Revoked grants are retained internally but no product action can read them.
open_points.default_guess: Authorization reads only the active grant, while an administrator history or audit action reads every generation.

witness.initial: Viewer V has one revoked historical grant and one active grant for project P.
events: An administrator or auditor reads V's grants for P.
outcomes: Both the revoked and active records are returned.
Only the active record is returned.

open_points.subject: Model M15 — ProducerProjectGrant authorization effect
open_points.text:
Grants are consulted only when the principal's `scope_mode` is
  `granted_projects`.
open_points.question: When scope_mode is granted_projects, does only an active grant authorize all of the principal's allowed source types and import-side capabilities for that project, and does revocation immediately remove that authorization?
options: Only an active grant authorizes the principal's otherwise allowed capabilities for the project; revocation removes authorization immediately.
Any retained grant, including a revoked grant, satisfies project scope.
The grant authorizes only an unspecified subset of the principal's capabilities or source types.
open_points.default_guess: Only an active grant authorizes the principal's otherwise allowed capabilities for the project; revocation removes authorization immediately.

witness.initial: A principal with scope_mode granted_projects has an active grant for project P and an otherwise permitted import capability and source type.
events: The principal attempts another import for P.
outcomes: The import is refused because no active grant remains.
The retained revoked grant is still consulted as sufficient project scope.
witness.observer: The service principal and the administrator reviewing the import result.

open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant fields
open_points.text:
- **Fields:** `grant_id: UUID`, `viewer_id: UUID`, `project_id: UUID`,
  `status: GrantStatus (active | revoked)`, `created_at`, `created_by`,
  `revoked_at | None`, `revoked_by | None`.
open_points.question: Give created_at, created_by, revoked_at and revoked_by explicit types, including the nullable base types of the revocation fields.
